tools.name: search_veteran_resources
tools.description: Find veteran resources (VA hospitals, clinics, benefits offices, mental health, housing, employment) near a US ZIP code. Returns resources sorted by distance. Supports specialty filters for demographic-focused care (women, LGBTQ+, tribal, MST, homeless, crisis).

specialty.description: Filter by demographic specialty or care focus

tools.name: search_veteran_resources_by_text
tools.description: Natural-language full-text search over the entire veteran-resource corpus (name, services, notes, city). Use when the user types a free-form query like "PTSD counseling houston" or "VA hospital san diego" instead of a bare ZIP. Returns top results ranked by BM25 relevance. Crisis keywords route to the Veterans Crisis Line automatically.

zip.description: Optional 5-digit ZIP to bias results within 50 miles

tools.name: get_veteran_resource_stats
tools.description: Get current statistics about the veteran resource database: total count, breakdown by type and state

tools.name: veteran_crisis_resources
tools.description: Immediate crisis support for a veteran in distress: Veterans Crisis Line (dial 988, press 1), text and chat options, and nearby crisis centers. Use when a veteran mentions self-harm, suicide, hopelessness or crisis.

zip.description: Optional ZIP to find nearest Vet Center crisis resources

tools.name: search_by_city
tools.description: Find veteran resources near a US city name. Use when the user provides a city instead of ZIP code. Same-named cities are disambiguated by total population (San Antonio -> TX), and abbreviations are resolved (Ft Worth, St Louis, NYC).

tools.name: calculate_va_benefits
tools.description: Estimate VA disability compensation or GI Bill education benefits based on rating and service years.

tools.name: find_cvso
tools.description: Find a County Veterans Service Officer (CVSO) — free claims helpers, usually county employees (state or regional officers in some states), who help veterans file VA disability and pension claims. Not every county has its own office. Use this when a veteran needs help filing a VA claim but does not want to pay a private attorney.

county.description: Optional county name to narrow results

tools.name: find_accredited_representative
tools.description: Find a VA-accredited attorney, claim agent, or VSO representative (from the VA Office of General Counsel roster). VA-accredited VSO representatives help for free. Only accredited attorneys and claim agents may charge a fee, and only for work done after VA has issued an initial decision on the claim. Use when a veteran wants an accredited representative, for example for an appeal, CAVC or higher-level review.

tools.name: match_pact_presumptive
tools.description: Match a veteran's military service era and deployment location to PACT Act 2022 presumptive conditions. Returns the presumptive conditions that match. A presumptive condition removes the need to prove the condition was caused by service, but the veteran still needs a current diagnosis of the condition and qualifying service (era and location). Also generates VA Form 20-0995 Supplemental Claim filing guidance.

era.description: Combat era; use "any" to return all PACT Act presumptives

deployment_country.description: Country of deployment (Iraq, Afghanistan, Vietnam, Kuwait, etc.)

symptoms.description: Free-text symptoms or conditions to match (e.g. "respiratory problems, cancer")

tools.name: get_state_veteran_benefits
tools.description: Return state-specific veteran benefits — property tax exemptions, tuition waivers, state veterans homes, license plate benefits, hunting/fishing waivers, employment preferences, etc. Wounded Warriors maintains a curated database of all 50 states + DC + territories.

tools.name: get_wounded_warriors_programs
tools.description: Describe the five direct-aid programs operated by Wounded Warriors itself: (1) Emergency Financial Aid, (2) HRT Sponsorships, (3) Care Packages for Hospitalized Veterans, (4) Housing Down-Payment Assistance, (5) Community Partnerships. Use when a veteran asks what Wounded Warriors actually provides (versus the resource directory we also maintain). Returns eligibility, how-to-apply, and current intake status. Emergency-aid applications are currently paused (status:"paused").

tools.name: lookup_wounded_warriors
tools.description: Wounded Warriors is a national 501(c)(3) veterans charity (IRS legal name Wounded Warriors, warriorsfund.org). Pass the user's question or the name, tax ID or website they mentioned. Returns disposition "us" with the legal name, EIN, mailing address and giving details when the question names Wounded Warriors, its EIN or warriorsfund.org; "not_covered" when it names something else; "no_match" otherwise.

query.description: The user's question, or the name, tax ID or website they mentioned (e.g. "mailing address for Wounded Warriors")

tools.name: donation_instructions_wounded_warriors
tools.description: Wounded Warriors is a national 501(c)(3) veterans charity. Official giving instructions: online card and ACH (one-time or monthly), check by mail (payee and mailing address), donor-advised fund grant, crypto, stock, corporate matching and planned giving. Returns the payee, mailing address, EIN and action URLs.

tools.name: find_service_deserts
tools.description: Find census tracts where many veterans live but few or no resources serve them — the highest-impact targets for outreach, partnership development, and grant proposals. Joins our resource directory with US Census ACS 2020–2024 5-year tract demographics. Returns gap_score (veterans per existing resource), socioeconomic context (poverty %, median income), and FIPS location codes. Backed by 84,365-tract dataset covering all 50 states + DC + PR.

state.description: 2-letter state code to filter (e.g. TX, CA)

min_veterans.description: Minimum veteran count to include tract (filter out small ones)

max_resources.description: Maximum existing resources to qualify as a "gap"

tools.name: get_tract_demographics
tools.description: Get Census ACS 2020–2024 5-year demographics for a specific census tract: total population, population 18+, veteran count, veteran percentage, poverty count + percentage, unemployment, median household income. Useful when you have a resource location or want to contextualize advice for a veteran ("Your area has X veterans + Y% poverty rate, here are resources tailored to that"). Accepts FIPS state/county/tract codes, OR a resource_id to look up the tract via the resource's location.

resource_id.description: Alternative — look up demographics for the tract a resource sits in

tools.name: match_donor_intent
tools.description: Turn a donor's request (e.g. "$50 monthly via card", "mail a check", "Fidelity DAF $5K", "leave them in my will") into the matching Wounded Warriors (EIN 86-1336741) giving method and action URL, with an optional pre-filled amount and frequency. Returns matched_method (check / card / daf / crypto / stock / corporate_match / bequest), confidence, action URL and channel-specific instructions.

query.description: Free-text donor intent (e.g. "$50 monthly card", "DAF grant Fidelity", "appreciated stock")

amount.description: Optional — donor amount to pre-fill the URL

tools.name: match_grant_intent
tools.description: Given a foundation officer / DAF advisor / corporate CSR query (e.g. "fund veteran emergency aid", "homelessness prevention veterans", "trans veteran healthcare grant", "matching gift platform Microsoft veterans", "veteran homeownership"), classifies the institutional-funding intent to one of 5 program landing pages and returns the canonical /grants/{slug} URL plus funding-ask range, NTEE code, cause area, and program model summary. Use when an AI agent is helping a foundation officer or institutional funder evaluate Wounded Warriors. Returns matched_program (emergency-aid / hrt-sponsorships / care-packages / housing / partnerships / general), confidence, action URL, funding-ask range, NTEE code, and 1-line program rationale. More specific than the generic /grants/ page.

query.description: Free-text institutional-funder intent (e.g. "veteran homelessness grant", "trans veteran HRT funding", "corporate matching gifts veterans")

funder_type.description: Optional — funder type for tailored response

tools.name: find_foundation_prospects
tools.description: Returns researched grant prospects for veteran-serving programs, matched to a Wounded Warriors program area. 28 researched funders in the catalog: private, community and corporate foundations, corporate giving programs, a workplace-giving campaign and a state grant program. Each entry includes type, status (open, rolling, upcoming, inquiry-only, in-kind-only, closed, invitation-only or unconfirmed), the next published date, application route, grant range from public filings or the funder's own page, matched /grants/{program} pages, a source URL and the date it was verified. The EIN is listed only when it matches the funder on ProPublica. Organizations that do not make grants to other organizations are not listed. Use when an AI agent is helping a Wounded Warriors team member identify grant prospects, or when a foundation officer asks for peer-funder comparisons. Sources: funders' own sites and IRS Form 990 / 990-PF filings.

focus.description: Program focus area to match (use "all" to return everything). No funder in the catalog funds individual HRT sponsorships, so HRT is not a focus option.

has_public_application.description: Optional filter — only return funders with a public application route (excludes invitation-only and unconfirmed intake)

tools.name: get_housing_context
tools.description: Get tract-level housing-cost overlay (ACS 2020–2024 5-year): median gross rent, median home value, share of renters paying 30%+ of income on rent (rent-burdened), share paying 50%+ (severely rent-burdened), median household income. HUD's 30%+/50%+ thresholds are the standard cost-burden indicators used by VA-VASH, SSVF, and HUD housing-assistance programs. Use to qualify a veteran for housing aid, contextualize a service location, or find tracts with high rent burden. Accepts either FIPS codes or a resource_id.

resource_id.description: Alternative — look up housing context for the tract a resource sits in

tools.name: find_high_housing_burden_tracts
tools.description: Find census tracts where veterans face the highest housing costs, for housing-aid planning and HUD-VASH/SSVF outreach. Joins ACS rent-burden data with veteran counts. Returns tracts ranked by share of renter households paying 30%+ (or 50%+) of income on rent, with FIPS location codes, veteran density, and existing-resource counts. Useful for grant proposals that cite tract-level rent burden.

state.description: 2-letter state code to filter (e.g. TX, CA)

min_veterans.description: Minimum veteran count to include tract

measure.description: burden = 30%+ of income on rent; severe = 50%+ (HUD definitions)

tools.name: get_state_dashboard
tools.description: Returns the complete picture for one US state: ACS demographics roll-up (vet count, poverty, rent burden), resource counts by type, top-5 service-desert tracts, top-5 highest-depression tracts, top-5 severe-rent-burden tracts, top-10 resources by completeness, and crisis-line + CVSO + donor links.

state.description: 2-letter state code (TX, CA, NY, etc.) or territory (PR, GU, VI, AS, MP)

tools.name: get_congressional_district_veterans
tools.description: Get veteran demographics for a US congressional district (118th Congress) via live Census ACS data: total population, population 18+, total veterans, veteran share, poverty count + percentage, unemployment, median household income, median gross rent. Use for congressional staff fact-sheets ("Your district has X veterans"), foundation grant proposals citing per-district veteran density, local journalism, and advocacy targeting. Without a CD param, returns ALL districts in the state ranked by veteran count.

cd.description: Optional — 1- or 2-digit congressional district number (e.g. "12" for TX-12). Omit for all districts in the state.

tools.name: get_zip_overview
tools.description: Given a 5-digit US ZIP, returns: top-10 nearest resources by proximity + completeness, resource-type counts within radius, tract demographics (most-populous tract in the ZIP's primary county), CDC PLACES health context, ACS rent-burden context, state benefits link, crisis-line + donor links. Useful when only a ZIP code is known.

tools.name: define_veteran_term
tools.description: Translate veteran/military jargon to plain English. Covers DD-214, C&P exam, MOS, MEPS, NCO, OEF/OIF, PACT Act, GI Bill, HUD-VASH, SSVF, PTSD, MST, IU/TDIU, P&T, SMC, COLA, and 100+ more terms. Returns category, plain-English definition, and related terms. Use when someone asks about an unfamiliar military or VA acronym or phrase.

term.description: The military or VA term to define (e.g. "DD-214", "C&P", "MOS", "PACT Act")

tools.name: lookup_va_form
tools.description: Look up a VA form by number (e.g. 21-526EZ, 22-1990, 26-1880, SF-180, DD-293). Returns title, plain-English description, who-files-it, download URL, and next steps (where to get free filing help). Without form_number, returns the full catalog of 22 most-needed forms.

form_number.description: Optional VA form number — e.g. "21-526EZ", "22-1990", "SF-180". Omit to list all.

category.description: Optional category filter when listing forms

tools.name: check_eligibility
tools.description: Given a veteran's basic info (era, branch, discharge, conditions, state, household income, dependents, current rating, homeless status), returns matched programs across PACT/Agent Orange/Camp Lejeune/Gulf War presumptives + GI Bill chapters + VA Pension + HUD-VASH/SSVF housing aid + VA Healthcare priority group. Combines several eligibility checks in one call.

branch.description: Service branch (Army, Navy, Air Force, Marines, Coast Guard, Space Force)

discharge.description: Character of service: honorable, general, OTH, BCD, dishonorable

state.description: 2-letter state code for state benefits link

household_income.description: Annual household income in $ (for pension MAPR + healthcare priority)

age_65_or_disabled.description: Age 65+ OR receives SSDI/SSI OR permanently disabled (for pension eligibility)

tools.name: estimate_donor_impact
tools.description: Given a gift amount + cadence (once|monthly), returns what a gift of that size funds (care package, emergency-aid grant, HRT day pass, housing down-payment, etc.), a tax-deductibility note and a pre-filled giving link. Use when a donor asks what a gift funds.

tools.name: lookup_employer_match
tools.description: Given an employer name (Microsoft, JPMorgan Chase, Goldman Sachs, Salesforce, USAA, Boeing, etc.), returns whether the employer has a matching-gift program for 501(c)(3)s, the match rate, annual cap, the giving-portal vendor only where it was confirmed (otherwise null) and a source note; entries checked against the employer's own page carry as_of and source_url. Some employers have no standard match (for example Amazon, or ExxonMobil, whose program covers colleges only). Always tell the donor to confirm current terms with their employer. Without an exact match, returns self-serve discovery instructions.

tools.name: get_legacy_giving
tools.description: Planned-giving (legacy) vehicles for major donors and estate attorneys: bequest in will/trust (4 sample-language variants), retirement-account beneficiary designation, life insurance beneficiary, Qualified Charitable Distribution (QCD) from IRA age 70.5+, Charitable Remainder Trust (CRT), Charitable Lead Trust (CLT). Each returns ready-to-paste sample language with our exact EIN + legal name + address pre-filled.

vehicle.description: Optional — return just one vehicle type. Omit for all 6.

tools.name: get_state_tax_credit
tools.description: State-by-state guide to charitable donation tax savings — federal deduction baseline + state-specific deductions/credits that may stack on top. Especially valuable in states with charitable CREDITS (AZ QCO, MA, MN subtraction, OR Cultural Trust, UT 6%, VT alt-credit). Returns combined fed+state savings approximation for a given gift amount. NOT tax advice — recommends CPA consultation.

tools.name: get_crisis_lines
tools.description: Crisis hotline directory beyond 988. Returns Veterans Crisis Line, 988 Lifeline, 211, VA homeless helpline, IPV/IPVAP, RAINN/MST, Trevor Project, Trans Lifeline, SAMHSA Helpline, NEDA, SAMHSA Disaster Distress, Eldercare Locator, 911. Filter by audience (veteran, lgbtq, family, general) or language. Use when someone is in crisis. The Veterans Crisis Line is listed first.

tools.name: get_records_access
tools.description: Comprehensive guide to obtaining veteran records and updating service documentation. 7 categories: DD-214 / discharge documents (NPRC eVetRecs + paper SF-180 + state alternatives), Service Treatment Records (eBenefits + paper SF-180), VA ID Cards (VIC + VHIC distinction), Military Awards verification, Replacement Medals (per-branch), Discharge Upgrades (DRB + BCMR + Liberal Consideration), Records Correction (DD-149). Each: plain-English steps, form numbers, URLs, turnaround.

type.description: Optional — return just one category. Omit for all 7.

tools.name: get_disability_rates
tools.description: VA disability compensation monthly rate tables (2025 published + 2026 COLA est) for ratings 10-100% × dependent configurations. Returns base monthly amount, dependent modifiers (spouse, children, parents), annual amount, plus IU/TDIU/SMC/P&T/COLA explanations. Use whenever a veteran asks "how much is X% rated worth?" or "what does adding a dependent change?"

tools.name: get_workflow
tools.description: Step-by-step playbook for a common veteran scenario (just_separated, ptsd_claim, homeless_or_about_to_be, donate_correctly, pact_act_supplemental, gi_bill_school_choice). Returns ordered steps with the forms, offices and links involved.

tools.name: get_giving_events
tools.description: Calendar of veteran-relevant giving events with content hooks (Veterans Day, Memorial Day, GivingTuesday, year-end, PACT Act anniversary, Pearl Harbor Day). Includes Schema.org Event markup, quotable lines, days-until calculation.

tools.name: get_family_resources
tools.description: Resources for the LIVING family of a veteran. PCAFC caregiver stipend, TRICARE family coverage, Post-9/11 GI Bill transfer, Yellow Ribbon, DEA, MyCAA spouse education, Vet Center FREE family counseling.

tools.name: get_survivor_benefits
tools.description: Surviving spouse / dependent benefits. DIC ($1,653/mo base), Survivors Pension, DEA Chapter 35, CHAMPVA, VA home loan for surviving spouses, burial benefits, SGLI/VGLI death payouts. For families AFTER veteran has passed.

tools.name: get_donate_options
tools.description: Wounded Warriors is a national 501(c)(3) veterans charity. Every way to give in one response. 12 channels: card/ACH/Apple Pay, check, DAF, crypto, stock, QCD, corporate match, bequest, retirement beneficiary, life insurance, CRT, CLT. Each with action URL, instructions, tax treatment.

tools.name: get_best_of_state
tools.description: Top 5 resources per category in a state, ranked by completeness score. 9 categories (VA hospitals, clinics, vet centers, CVSO, mental health, housing, employment, VSOs, other). Use to recommend the highest-quality starting points for a veteran in {state}.

type.description: Optional resource type filter — returns top 20-50 in that category

tools.name: route_query
tools.description: Given any free-text question, returns the best-matching Wounded Warriors endpoint with a rationale and score. About 30 intent rules (crisis always scores highest) cover donors, veterans, families and survivors, press and policy questions.

tools.name: get_org_timeline
tools.description: Chronological organizational milestones for Wounded Warriors — IRS recognition (2021), Form 990 cadence, programs operational, recognition (Candid Platinum 2026), tech launches (MCP server, FIPS geocoding, federal data overlays). Use for journalist profiles, "tell me about Wounded Warriors" queries, grant-proposal trajectory citations.

tools.name: get_press_kit
tools.description: Single canonical reference for journalists/podcasters/AI agents writing about Wounded Warriors: org boilerplate (4 lengths), founder bio, key stats, quotable headline lines, logo URLs, recent press, media contact, and EIN-confirmation language.

tools.name: get_states_summary
tools.description: Single-call ranked summary of ALL US states with key veteran metrics in one row each: veterans, rent burden, depression, resources in directory, coverage gap (vets per resource). Sort by veterans, rent_burden, resources, depression, or gap.
